incident-bot: PagerDuty: ALERT firing — service=runtime-inference, symptom=p99_latency, window=15m, value=3.8s (SLO burn=18%). Pager: ENG_ONCALL_EU. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/p99-latency
jamie: ack — I'm on it. @kevin can you watch autoscaler + infra? @sana please check KV cache and hotkeys. :eyes:
kevin: on it. pulling autoscaler metrics now. any recent deploys?
luis: I saw a small canary pushed ~10m ago (model-serving v2-quant). flagging in case of perf regressions.
sana: KV eviction spikes around the same time. top key is search:session:1234 — very hot. starting a warmup/prefill for that prefix.
kevin: autoscaler shows surge; scaling requests queued because dedicated GPU pool in eu-west1 is at capacity (100% util). quota check in progress.
jamie: quick mitigation: enable fallback routing to latency-optimized model to bleed load while infra scales. @oncall-rota please apply routing patch: 
```
curl -X POST "https://internal-routing/api/v1/route" -d '{"service":"runtime-inference","route_pct":15,"target":"model-opt-latency"}' 
```
luis: applying routing change now, will push 15% traffic to model-opt-latency and monitor.
incident-bot: Routing-change detected: route_pct=15 -> model=model-opt-latency (timestamp=1812345725)
sana: warming complete for hot prefix, observing mem usage and eviction rate dropping. p99 should trend down once GPU pool utilization eases.
kevin: burst nodes requested and granted — added 4 GPUs to dedicated-1; utilization dropping to ~65% across pool. autoscaler backlog cleared.
jamie: seeing p99 drop: 3.8s -> 1.1s over ~4m. Good. Keeping page open for 30m for stability.
maria: support update — 12 customer sessions flagged as slow from real-user-monitoring; CS notified and holding template message ready.
amie: (typo) — jamie: assigning follow-ups: incident ticket + timeline. @kevin validate rollback/canary, @sana confirm KV tuning completed, @luis verify routing revert plan. handoff-checkin at 1812345800. :thumbsup:
